steps.en: Install the pack and name a concrete interface review scope
steps.zh: 安装技能包并指定具体界面评审范围

steps.en: Read project conventions and route six discipline reviews
steps.zh: 读取项目惯例并路由六个领域评审

steps.en: Collect evidence, consolidate root causes and mark coverage gaps
steps.zh: 收集证据、合并根因并标明覆盖缺口

steps.en: Return ranked findings, verification and a scoped verdict
steps.zh: 返回排序问题、验证记录和有范围的裁决

value.en: A review distinguishes real defects from taste and uninspected domains
value.zh: 评审能够区分真实缺陷、审美偏好和未检查领域
